scripts.dev: bun run train && bun run --parallel --filter "*" dev
scripts.build: bun run train && bun run --filter "*" build
scripts.typecheck: bun run train && tsc --noEmit && bun run --filter "*" typecheck
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run train && bun run check:prepared
scripts.train: bun run build:packages && bun run train:filters && bun run train:neural
scripts.build:packages: bun run build:core && bun run --filter @matchbox-ai/react build && bun run --filter @matchbox-ai/train build
scripts.train:neural: bun run matchbox train examples/is-even/matchbox.config.ts && bun run matchbox train examples/money/matchbox.config.ts
scripts.check:prepared: tsc --noEmit && bun run --filter "*" typecheck && bun test ./tests && bun run --filter "*" build
